New: _model_block_read(security_key, client) -- the RAW block + a 3-status record (SERVED/ABSENT/READ_FAILED), read with THIS call's OWN client against MODEL_BLOCK_POOL_PREFIX/POOL_BUCKET imported (never retyped) from scoped_amgt/pool_reader, the SAME newest-lexicographic-stamp selection scoped_amgt._read_model_block_pool implements (that helper itself is not called -- see row AMGT_CORPUS-Z-W2-S9); _model_block_stamp (parses the <stamp> path segment); _model_block_entry (block, record) -> {key, sha256} for `inputs`, sha256 of the RAW block's own canonical bytes, so inputs -- and the no-op-rebuild check -- move exactly when the stored block moves, never on the display-time corrected-price overlay; _figure_for_row_key (latest CLOSED fiscal-year figure for the row's mnemonic/label, else its HEADER figure, else its FY1 FORECAST figure; a miss carries the block's own `unresolved` record for that key when one exists); _figure_field (value/unit/source/stamp plus ONE period label keyed by the matched figure's own scope -- fiscal_year for fiscal_year_line_item, fiscal_period for forecast, neither for header). build()/current_inputs() thread the block entry into `inputs` (_build_inputs gained a model_block_entry parameter) and model_rows into `fields`. New CLI: --model-rows-probe --key <security_key> (read-only, no write) prints 'model_rows N with_value N absent N constant_reasons N inputs_model_block <uri|none>'.

NEW file, 10 tests, offline under conftest.py's poison. Exercises _model_rows/_figure_for_row_key/_figure_field/_model_block_entry/_model_block_stamp directly against a HAND-BUILT block/record (never a real S3/pool read -- the private block/record parameters ARE the seam that keeps this suite offline): (1) rows fill from a fixture block -- latest-closed-fiscal-year PX_LAST (2025 over 2024), a HEADER scalar, and an FY1 FORECAST figure, each carrying value/unit/(fiscal_year|fiscal_period)/source/stamp, no fiscal_period leaking onto the fiscal-year hit and no fiscal_year leaking onto the forecast hit; (2) an unresolved mnemonic carries the block's own unresolved reason, never the old constant; (3) a mnemonic/label the block does not carry at all yields the derived 'mnemonic <m> not carried by the Model block' reason, for BOTH a typecast mnemonic and a sector-template label; (4) a missing (ABSENT) block yields 'no derived Model block for <key>' on every row; (5) a READ_FAILED read is never reported as the ABSENT-block reason (asserts the two reasons differ and the READ_FAILED one names 'did not complete'); (6) FIGURE_ABSENT_REASON is not a module attribute any more; (7)/(8) the block is named in `inputs` (key+sha256), and the entry's sha256 moves when the block's own figures do; (9) the lookup order (fiscal-year-line-item, then header, then FY1 forecast) and the stamp parser, positive and negative; (10) the poison control. Typecast/sector-template fixtures are seeded through gold.gold_put against substrate.StubS3Client -- this package's own writer, never real boto3.

Row AMGT_CORPUS-Z-W2-S9 appended (append-only channel, validated by .tools/surprise-row-gate.py at commit time): scoped_amgt._read_model_block_pool takes no client argument and always resolves its own (env-driven, defaulting to a real boto3.client), so calling it directly from this module's client-threaded build()/current_inputs()/write_one() broke 4 of test_dossier.py's pre-existing offline tests under the package poison; resolved by reusing only the SELECTION RULE (prefix + newest-stamp) by literal import, reading through this call's OWN client instead -- the same idiom _list_stored_keys already uses in this file.
